verdict.rationale: Anthropic publishes a dedicated model-deprecations page with per-model retirement floors ('Not sooner than September 1, 2027') giving advance notice, plus a versioning policy that preserves input/output parameters across model versions and a model-IDs/versions page distinguishing pinned vs. moving IDs for migration planning. This directly matches the story's requirements of documented policy, advance notice, and migration guidance. Missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of actual advance-notice practice or migration smoothness during a real retirement event.
